title: Google Maps remains VeloRail default map surface
rationale: VR-000 added docs/architecture/google-maps-first-policy.md documenting Google Maps Platform as the default rendering, routing, geocoding, Places, and overlay surface, with custom logic limited to documented future overlays, GTFS, freight corridor data, and simulation exceptions with provenance.

name: Google Maps overlay registry
description: Centralize VeloRail-owned proposal overlays as MapOverlayDefinition records, render them through MapOverlayRenderer, and keep visibility state in the map overlay store so Google Maps remains the base map and interaction surface.

name: Future Transit overlay controls
description: VR-101/VR-102/VR-103 keeps Future Transit as one default-off registry toggle that groups official planned/funded/under-construction proposal lines and stations. Rendering consumes imported proposal overlay output, uses Google Maps Polyline/Marker/InfoWindow objects, filters future records to official statuses, holds future station markers until zoom 11 to reduce clutter, and exposes station phase/opening plus provenance links in metadata.

name: Overlay metadata click interaction
description: VR-004 uses Google Maps polyline and marker click listeners to open an InfoWindow and dispatch velorail:map-overlay-metadata-selected for the React metadata panel. Metadata includes status, classification, confidence, uncertainty, ownership/operator details, and provenance links without replacing Google Maps hit testing.

name: Freight corridor overlay rendering
description: VR-403 renders freight and converted-passenger proposal layer groups through the nationalized overlay using Google Maps polylines. Freight-only corridors use dotted symbol strokes, freight badges, and click metadata sourced from the freight proposal records; performance stays bounded by one polyline plus station markers per proposal and visibility sync on zoom changes.

name: Config-driven Google Maps overlay styling
description: VR-003 centralizes overlay line, marker, legend, and badge metadata in MAP_OVERLAY_STYLE_CONFIG. Proposal renderers resolve current, context, future, visionary, freight_only, and converted_passenger styles through the registry so Google Maps polylines, markers, and the visible legend use the same status-family contract.

name: Completed network comparison mode
description: VR-104 adds a comparison mode control that synchronizes the official future overlay with Present Only versus Present + Future state, keeps Future Transit official-only, and exposes the mode in the shared layer legend rather than changing route planner behavior.

outcomes.test_results: npm run quality passed after merge; browser coverage verifies present/future mode state and legend copy.

name: Freight suitability and candidate route generation
description: VR-406/VR-500 score freight corridors with a deterministic checked-in-data heuristic and export review-only passenger route candidates from freight corridor topology. Scores expose method, factors, missing data, and uncertainty; candidates stay needs_review and are not promoted to official service.

outcomes.test_results: npm run test, lint, typecheck, build passed; strict browser preflight for @VR-204/@VR-406 passed.
